readout: ridge on standardized 18 one-body Pauli expectations, alpha=1e-6, intercept
features: reset-window replay with each frozen W
basis: per channel, polynomials orthonormal on the empirical distribution of the probe training rows (Gram-Schmidt on 1, x, x^2, x^3); degrees with zero residual are skipped; the binary holiday channel H enters only linear targets

families.cross: phi1(u_i(t-k1)) phi1(u_j(t-k2)), all pairs of (channel, delay)

correction: corrected = max(raw - 1/(365-1), 0) if raw > 99th percentile of a permutation null (300 random targets, seed 2027, per candidate) else 0
